rules: rule 1: layer=-1 alone is no tunnel: the trough between the Schuetzenallee and the Kappler Tunnel (eastbound w25774610 / w25774618, westbound w36926374 / w697073965) is open
rule 4: open level < 0 stretches are cuttings at the structure's height: from one tube's floor to the next tube's floor, never at grade (cut_at_grade 0)

rule 5: town approaches are walled (west entrance): the wall's top at the mouth is the portal's headwall top, then one even fall to the street level beside; the inner face flush with the opening (gap 0); the ground behind held at the top
rule 6: the Schuetzenallee-Tunnel is a town box (both carriageways)
rule 7: its two tubes are one twin box where their walls come within 3 m (see b31_twin_box)
rule 12: the westbound's galleries (w1481396356, w1481396355: tunnel=avalanche_protector, open side left = south toward the eastbound trough) join the box tubes at joints with one floor (no step)

rule_vs_prototype.rule: T1 rule P: a portal moves outward by at most X_MAX 30 m (100 ft) where the bare ground just outside the mapped end stands more than D_CUT (15 m rural / 8 m town) over the profile; never inward
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: never moved: the portal stays at the mapped end (rule 2)
rule_vs_prototype.here: no snap in this case (t1_actual.snaps is empty): both agree

rule_vs_prototype.rule: the maintainer: the floor is the profile's (prof.rs) within its grade limits, not forced straight pin to pin; measured floors win
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: rule 3: the lower hull of the ground between the pins, sunk where the cover over the crown is under 1 m (MAPPED_COVER_M), rounded over 12 m
rule_vs_prototype.here: floor_at values are 'prototype' (reference, +-0.30 m); portals and joints are the pins both agree on

rule_vs_prototype.rule: T1: kind 2 (full) where the axis cover >= TUBE_H 6.8 + LID_MARGIN 0.5 = 7.3 m, else kind 1 (lid); the maintainer's later split: bore at >= 8 m cover over >= 60 m, thinner a box, under the opening + 0.45 m a lid box
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: decided per mapped part: a town tunnel (buildings within 30 m) under a median cover over the crown below BOX_COVER_M 4 m is a cut-and-cover box end to end (4.70 m clear + 0.80 m roof), else a bore (6.8 m); a low arch only where the cover sizes it down
rule_vs_prototype.here: expected.t1.expected_from_prototype codes a box as 2 ('full', label box_town); T1 itself gives 1 (lid) where the box's cover is under 7.3 m (near the mouths): see t1_actual

rule_vs_prototype.rule: the maintainer: maxheight + 10 in (else a table by class and country) + 1 ft
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: a box 4.70 m clear (RABT 4.50 m + margin), a bore's tube 6.8 m

rule_vs_prototype.rule: TUBE_H 6.8 (also for a box), X_MAX 30, D_CUT 15 / 8, GAP_COVER 2, GAP_MIN_M 40, MIN_RUN_M 10, HOLE_OVER 1, HOLE_MAX_M 60
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: box section 5.5 m over the floor (the terrain is cut and raised to the roof's top), open gaps inside a mapped part never (covered end to end), no lid / full split inside a part

rule_vs_prototype.rule: T1 has no gallery kind (the maintainer: a section type inside the record, T5)
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: a gallery is a part of its own: roof, mountain wall, columns on the open side, its floor the road's own grade
rule_vs_prototype.here: coded 2 with label 'gallery' and open_side; a T5 kind 3 is the proposal

rule_vs_prototype.rule: T1 / the maintainer: inside a mapped range a daylight gap only where axis and both sides lie under floor + 2 m for 40 m or more
rule_vs_prototype.prototype: the trough is no mapped range (no flag, no OSM tunnel tag): a cutting
rule_vs_prototype.here: outside every tunnel range: t1_code null

notes: The eastbound's line starts at the west end (s 0 = w9982057); the westbound's runs east to west (its window starts at feature station 1300, inside the Kappler Tunnel w10042282, a joint).
The westbound box (Kappler) -> gallery joint at s 71.5 and the gallery -> box (Schuetzenallee) joint at s 1326.3 have one floor each (308.296 / 292.181 on both sides).

Known rests in check_rows: tube_intrusion 1 (0.5 m2 of a wall at 47.98299, 7.89067), floor_ground 2 (the gallery floor rows at 47.98431, 7.88389 / 47.98514, 7.87852), town_bank 2 at the west entrance, wall_top_teeth 5 on the trough's older cutting walls, outside_no_edge 1.

The DEM is a lidar DTM that already shows the real trench at the west entrance; the branching street's crossfall there (two drawn carriageways at different heights overlapping, no shared node) is parked: the maintainer's road system levels a road across its width.

T1 (upstream/dev e02936ea..f4170f7e, tunnel::stroke_record run on these stations): the westbound gallery w1481396355 (s 1067.8-1326.3) is in no tunnel range, because Overture gives it no flag (avalanche_protector only, no covered=yes): T1 leaves it open and puts a portal at s 1326.2, where the prototype has a gallery -> box joint. The tags in the shards (#1544 Q3) close this. The is_covered gallery w1481396356 is a range: T1 codes it 1 (lid) with a portal at s 657.7, as the prototype's gallery mouth.
T1 codes the town boxes 1 (lid) for their first and last 11-64 m, where the cover is under 7.3 m, and 2 inside; the prototype builds one box end to end.

town_ramp_walls come from the road tiles' real build (wallprobe.py, tilesmoke round 47.9884, 7.8645); the per_carriageway walls are tunnelscan's place-wide first wall call (no portal tops passed), so their tops at the west entrance are lower: use town_ramp_walls for rule 5.

portal.s.reason: rule 2: the portal stands at the mapped end of the tagged range (the station of the mapped vertex; 1 m = the line's resampling); T1 rule P may move it outward only (X_MAX 30 m), never inward

portal.floor.reason: the prototype's floor at the mouth; the rule behind it: within 0.5 m of the road's own approach line (rule 2, PORTAL_END_HIGH_M / mouth_step), never a DEM sample over the mouth, never a neighbour's cutting

portal.roof_top.reason: floor + the section's height: a box 4.70 m clear + 0.80 m roof = 5.50 m, a full bore 6.80 m (roadmesh.TUNNEL_H), a major road's low arch 5.0 m

floor_at.reason: the prototype's floor (rule 3: the lower hull between the pins, sunk where the cover over the crown is under 1 m, rounded over 12 m); the maintainer's floor comes from prof.rs within its grade limits, so these are reference values, not targets

section.s0_s1.reason: rule 1: a tunnel is the tagged range (is_tunnel / is_covered / tunnel=*), per range; a joint between two mapped parts is where the map splits them

section.label.reason: box_town / box_twin (rule 6: a town tunnel under thin cover is a cut-and-cover box; rule 7 twins), bore, low_arch, gallery (rule 12), cutting (rule 4: an open level < 0 stretch); t1_code is T1's 0 gap / 1 lid / 2 full for the same stretch

wall.face_offset.reason: rule 5 (task 7n): the wall's inner face is flush with the opening's side (the tube's half width = carriageway half width + 1.2 m shoulder)
